//: RCS pilot configuration template (docs/PILOT_DEPLOYMENT.md). Copy to /opt/rcs/appsettings.Pilot.json and adjust.
Set DOTNET_ENVIRONMENT=Pilot in the service unit so this file is the one that loads.
NO SECRETS HERE: connection strings with passwords belong in the secrets file named by RCS_SECRETS_FILE,
owned by the service user with mode 0600, or in a PostgreSQL .pgpass. This file may be world-readable.

ConnectionStrings.//: Host=/var/run/postgresql keeps PostgreSQL on a local Unix socket: it is never reachable from a workstation.

Review.//: The Development review actor. It must stay false: the host refuses to start with it on outside Development.

Authentication.//: Argon2id cost is tuned on the real server and recorded with every hash (SECURITY.md 6.2).
Authentication.//RequireSecureCookie: Keep true behind the nginx TLS front end. Only a deliberately plain-HTTP pilot sets it false, and PILOT_READINESS.md records that as an explicit exception.

Storage.//: Real business bytes, outside the release directory. The host refuses to start if these sit inside it.

Sandbox.//: Bubblewrap is mandatory outside Development. LauncherPrefix can add a dedicated preview identity.

Hosting.//: The name the employee types. A hostname, never a baked-in IP address.
